description: This file defines a LoginFragment class that handles user authentication functionalities in the mobile application, including login and sign-up processes.

classes.name: LoginFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides the UI and logic for user login and registration functionalities.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the login fragment and initializes the binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up listeners and observes the UI state after the view is created.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for login and sign up buttons.

methods.name: observeUiState
methods.description: Observes the authentication UI state and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Shows or hides the loading indicators based on the loading state.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message using a Snackbar when login or sign up fails.

methods.name: navigateToHome
methods.description: Navigates to the home fragment after successful authentication.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the binding reference when the view is destroyed.
